q: Towns can no longer hoard: each purse now stops at 3,000 / 6,000 / 12,000 / 20,000 gold (by Town level). One loophole is left. A rich Town still earns about 300–500 gold a minute more than it spends, and Take can pull 1,000 every 2 minutes from each Town. Clicking Take on all 7 Towns every 2 minutes would bring about 2,300 gold a minute, double the Tariff (about 1,150 a minute late in a run). Limit how often Take can be used?
ctx: Lowering Tax instead was tested: it leaves importing Towns broke and needing Gives 4–5 times as often.
o: Once every 10 minutes per Town (at most ~700 gold a minute from 7 Towns: below the Tariff)
Once every 5 minutes per Town (at most ~1,400 a minute: still above the Tariff)
Leave it: clicking every Town every 2 minutes is chore enough
